description: Perform a skill or ability test for a character. Rolls d20 + ability + skill + modifiers vs difficulty; in a roll-under world it rolls the world's die against ability + skill + modifiers instead, and `difficulty` is ignored. Supports advantage/disadvantage. Returns an envelope with `outcome` (five-tier) and a one-line `summary` as the headline; mechanical detail is in `result`, follow-up moves in `suggested_next`.

ability.description: Ability id to use, from the session's world (the default world: STR, AGI, WIT, CON). Optional: defaults to the skill's ability, else the world's default test ability (WIT in the default world).

autoTickClockIds.description: Clock IDs to automatically tick on partial/failure outcomes. In worlds that turn clock auto-tick off (mechanics.fitd.clockAutoTick) they are not ticked; they come back as suggested_next.tick_clocks instead.

difficulty.description: Difficulty level: easy (DC 8), standard (DC 12, default), hard (DC 16), extreme (DC 20). For an exact custom DC, use roll_custom_test instead. Ignored in roll-under worlds, where the target is ability + skill + modifiers.

effectLevel.description: Effect level (impact): limited, standard (default), great. Ignored in worlds without position and effect (mechanics.fitd.positionEffect).

position.description: Position (risk level): controlled, risky (default), desperate. Ignored in worlds without position and effect (mechanics.fitd.positionEffect).

name: roll_test
